firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently rode a roller coaster begins.
clarifications: That player rolls all five dice; play continues clockwise.

internalEvidence: A HABA-authored original booklet is preserved by the Province of Liège. The 28-page PDF identifies © HABA Spiele Bad Rodach 2017, Tiny Park by Marco Teubner. The English section on printed page 8/PDF page 8 was rendered and read visually. Downloaded PDF SHA-256: 28ef121080dc66048dc2e4ac3699be94fc3443fdbb6054ac9258afe15593e511. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The booklet does not specify a tie-break or fallback when nobody has ridden a roller coaster.
